items.title: Telnet, PuTTY, and Secure Shell (SSH) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Telnet, PuTTY, and Secure Shell (SSH)' (PDF 18): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Telnet remote device access (door bethe kisi device tak pohanchne) ke liye istemal hota hai. Yeh data encryption ke baghair bhejta hai. PuTTY remote login (door se login karna) ka mashhoor tool hai. SSH remote access ka secure (mehfooz) tareeqa hai. SSH safety ke liye data ko encrypt karta (khufia code mein badalta) hai. Yeh tools network devices manage karne (sambhalne) mein madad dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Router ko door se sambhalne ke liye Telnet ke bajaye SSH kyun behtar hai?
blocks.explanation: Telnet data (password samet) baghair encryption bhejta hai, jo raaste mein parha ja sakta hai; SSH data encrypt karta hai, is liye mehfooz hai.

items: Telnet: remote access, encryption nahi. PuTTY: remote login tool. SSH: encrypted, mehfooz remote access.
